title: Drowse
summary: DROWSE, verb intransitive drowz. 1. To sleep imperfectly or unsoundly; to slumber; to be heavy with sleepiness. 2. To look heavy; to be heavy or dull. DROWSE, verb transitive To make heavy with sleep;

inlines.v: DROWSE, verb intransitive drowz. 1. To sleep imperfectly or unsoundly; to slumber; to be heavy with sleepiness. 2. To look heavy; to be heavy or dull. DROWSE, verb transitive To make heavy with sleep; to make dull or stupid.
